title: Shinonome Akito — White-Hot Snowball Fight!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys.
I brought it over.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Awesome! Can we see what's inside?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow...! It's full of white balls!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Whoa, they're all so soft and squishy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
They're balls used for soft tennis.
That's why they're so squishy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Gathering all of these couldn't have been easy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, my friend in the soft tennis club ended up giving us a lot after I asked if they had any balls they didn't need anymore.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But they might be a little dirty since they actually used them for their club activities...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, that's not a problem at all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. What matters most is that we get to experience having a snowball fight!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you guys wanna have a snowball fight...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, so it'd be great if we were able to borrow that snowball maker you guys just mentioned!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you need a ton of snow for that thing to work.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But...
We really want to have a snowball fight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there something we can do for them?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well...
Our options seem to be to bring snow over or find a suitable substitute for snowballs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That was when you came up with the idea of using these balls instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remembered seeing in the news how this one competition didn't have enough snow to hold an actual snowball fight, so they ended up using soft tennis balls instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't come up with complicated rules on the fly like Kamishiro. I mean, we don't really need...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: These balls probably won't hurt since they're so soft, but we should still be allowed to block them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I brought a pot lid from the cafe!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I actually brought a frying pan with me♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If a ball comes my way, I'm going to send it out of the park!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, hold up!
Now we need to lay down some ground rules!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You can defend yourselves using your arms and hands, but no homers... Don't hit any balls back!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, give me back that lid and pan.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, break into the teams we just decided on.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Then, on me, Team Rin!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, we'll spend about three minutes on a warm-up fight. After that, we'll do this for real.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! That... Didn't hurt at all!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Now I'm not afraid of getting hit!
Time for my revenge, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take this! And this! And this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, KAITO!
All the balls you're deflecting are coming towards me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Eep! Wh-What happened?!
A ball just fell out of the sky...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, was that one of those disappearing pitches?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, it sort of came straight out of left field, so I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're tensing up way too much, Toya. Try relaxing your shoulders more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, you're not supposed to be giving the other team advice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't be such a spoilsport!
I know your next throw's gonna be a good one, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you! Here it comes, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, hit me with your best shot!
